text:
How many things I thought were sublime,

worthy of abundant tears!

What were they? The tears of memory,

and the pensive plains

through which their long rivers stretched.

But those waters carry no voice.

Everything was drowned and buried.

Greater than the things wept for

were the tears that wept for them.

And at a distance,

their image is a solitude now without meaning,

a false map our journey abandons,

for we always go beyond everything, farther...

translation.title: False Map
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's revision of past grief into a map abandoned by the ongoing journey.
